title: "The Question of Cost"
next_chapter_hook: "The moment the pact was sealed, a faint golden pattern emerged on Chen Ji's brow center—that was the mark the Tianji Record had branded onto his soul. From this moment on, his fate with this forbidden artifact became inextricably intertwined."

text.content: "That voice did not transmit through language but exploded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, like countless rivers of stars flowing into an abyss, like the first light of creation piercing through darkness. He saw—countless blurred figures kneeling in the Void, some laughing maniacally, some wailing silently, some already reduced to dust."

"'These are all your predecessors.' The transcendent consciousness stated calmly, without a trace of emotion. 'Without exception, they all chose to accept. But their combined lifespans only extended the Tianji Record's existence by another three thousand years.'"

"Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His consciousness floated in this void, feeling those residual obsessions—greed, fear, despair, unwillingness... Each emotion was like a fine needle, piercing his soul. He spoke slowly: 'So, what you need is not a prophet, but a sacrifice.'"

"The void shuddered for a moment. That consciousness seemed to be examining him, as if seeing something interesting for the first time. 'You are the first... to state it so directly.' That voice carried an indescribable undertone, 'But you are wrong. A sacrifice has no choice, while you do.'"

"Chen Ji let out a contemptuous laugh, that smirk sounding especially jarring in this emptiness: 'Choice? Accepting your power and then repaying with my life—this is called choice?' His soul condensed slightly, forming a clear outline, 'Rather, you've just found another way to bind me.'"

dialogue.content: "'You are very clever.' The consciousness did not deny, instead seeming to carry a hint of appreciation, 'But clever people often die from overcalculation. The previous inheritor, Ling Yuan, also questioned me like you did. He chose not to accept—guess what became of him?'"

text.content: "Ling Yuan. Chen Ji's heart sank sharply. That name he had seen in fragments on the broken pages—the old sect master of Tianqing Sect, the elder who had 'graciously sheltered' Chen Ji. So all along, the root of everything pointed here. He took a deep breath: 'What are you trying to say?'"

"'I'm merely letting you see the situation clearly.' The consciousness's voice became ethereal, 'Whether you accept or not, the Tianji Record has already recognized its master. It will not leave you until you die. And your life...' A string of numbers appeared in the void, constantly jumping before Chen Ji's eyes, 'Originally only had twenty-three years remaining.'"

"Twenty-three years. This number was like a blade, stabbing viciously into Chen Ji's heart. He had always thought he was just a talentless waste, destined to live a mediocre life. But now he knew—his life was even shorter than he imagined. 'Is this because of the Tianji Record?' he asked, suppressing a tremor."

dialogue.content: "'No, you were born this way.' The consciousness was calm to the point of cruelty, 'Every person chosen by the Tianji Record has an incomplete fate. This is the cost, and also the admission ticket to the pact.' After a pause, that voice spoke again, 'But accepting the pact, you may exchange for the possibility of changing your fate. Refuse, and you can only watch these twenty-three years drain away day by day.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji's consciousness churned violently in this void. Twenty-three years... He thought of his missing sister Chen Nian, of the truth he needed to find, of those unfinished schemes. If he only had twenty-three years, what meaning did any of this have? Unless—"

"'What are the specific terms of the pact?' Chen Ji raised his head, a sharp light flickering in his eyes, 'Since you mentioned choice, you must let me know the specific terms of cost and gain. I don't do business with empty promises.'"

"That consciousness fell silent for a moment. Then, a massive scroll slowly unfolded before Chen Ji—a contract with terms chillingly clear: First, the contractor gains three-shichen Foresight Ability, with Heavenly Fate consumption ranging from 5 to 50 points depending on distance. Second, each use of this ability reduces the contractor's lifespan by corresponding days. Third, the Tianji Record will auto-repair, with repair progress linked to Heavenly Fate value."

choice.prompt: "The contract's cost was already clear; Chen Ji had to make a decision within limited time. Twenty-three years of life in exchange for a chance to rewrite fate—how should he calculate this account?"

choices.description: "Exchange Heavenly Fate for power, seizing a slim chance of survival in desperate circumstances. Though twenty-three years is short, if he can foresee crises and plan ahead, he might change his fate."
choices.visible_cost: "Each use of Foresight Ability reduces lifespan; initially only twenty-three years remaining"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain three-shichen Foresight Ability, can glimpse key future events"
choices.risk_hint: "Using life as collateral, if used frequently, the Foresight Ability will instead shorten his life"

text.content: "Chen Ji stared at that contract, a mocking arc curving his lips. He didn't hesitate long—in this void, time had no meaning anyway. 'Fine.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'I accept.'"

"The moment those words fell, that contract ignited furiously. Golden flames spread along Chen Ji's soul, branding a scalding mark deep in his consciousness. At that moment, he felt something forcibly inserted into his soul—a pair of eyes, capable of seeing everything that would happen within three shichen."

choices.description: "Don't make impulsive choices; first争取时间了解更多信息. Heavenly Fate is precious; don't recklessly stake everything."
choices.visible_cost: "Temporarily unable to use Foresight Ability, missing the first-mover advantage"
choices.visible_reward: "Preserve Heavenly Fate value, wait for more information"
choices.risk_hint: "Time is tight; hesitation may miss the crucial moment to change fate"

text.content: "'Wait.' Chen Ji raised his hand, making a pause gesture, 'Twenty-three years of life is no small matter. Before signing, I need to know what you truly are, what the Tianji Record's real purpose is.'"

"That consciousness fell silent. This silence made Chen Ji feel a hint of unease—he was probing the other's bottom line, and this probe seemed to have touched something that shouldn't be touched. After a long while, that voice spoke again: 'Some things are not for you to know now.'"

choices.description: "Attempt to negotiate with the Tianji Record consciousness, strive for more favorable terms. His life is his own; why should the other side decide?"
choices.visible_cost: "Negotiation failure may激怒天机录意识，影响后续关系"
choices.visible_reward: "若成功，可降低天命值消耗比例，或延长初始寿命"
choices.risk_hint: "天机录意识喜怒无常，触怒它可能招致不可预知的后果"

text.content: "Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly—this was his habitual expression when calculating. 'I have another proposal.' He said slowly, 'I can accept the twenty-three years of life. But I want to modify the terms—I want to know the specific conversion method for the Foresight Ability's consumption, and I want a guaranteed number of uses.'"

"A strange fluctuation rippled through the void, as if some ancient existence was chuckling. 'Interesting.' That voice carried distinct emotion for the first time, 'You are the first to dare bargain with me. But do you think you have the qualifications?'"

"Just then, a weak fluctuation came from the depths of the void. Chen Ji sensed it—that was Mo Xiansheng's aura, that wisp of residual soul was trying to approach him. The Tianji Record consciousness clearly noticed this too; that transcendent existence snorted coldly: 'Your reinforcement has arrived. But remember, the contract only gives you three breaths of consideration time.'"

"'Chen Ji.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying urgency, 'Whatever it says, don't trust it easily. The Tianji Record's contract is never a fair trade—it wants everything from you, while you can only get what it is willing to give.' An emotion Chen Ji had never heard before colored the old man's tone—something between fury and fear."

dialogue.content: "'Clamorous.' The transcendent consciousness spoke indifferently, its tone carrying undeniable authority, 'A dying man dares interfere with the contract's progression?' An invisible force seemed to press down from the void; Mo Xiansheng's voice immediately became fragmented."

text.content: "Chen Ji felt that pressure, his heart icy. The Tianji Record consciousness was far more terrifying than he imagined—even a guardian's residual soul could be casually suppressed. But this also made him清醒—对抗这存在，无异于以卵击石. He took a deep breath and made his decision."

choice.prompt: "Mo Xiansheng's warning echoed in his ears, the Tianji Record's pressure surrounded him on all sides. Chen Ji had to make his final choice within three breaths—accept this unknown-filled contract, or seek another way?"

choices.description: "Since there is no alternative, might as well embrace it proactively. Whether twenty-three years or thirty-three, he will personally rewrite this ending."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose equal negotiating standing with the Tianji Record consciousness, accept all附加条款"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain Foresight Ability, and complete usage rights to the Tianji Record Fragment"
choices.risk_hint: "Completely subject to the contract;日后若想摆脱枷锁将付出更大代价"

text.content: "'I sign.' Chen Ji's voice echoed in the void, calm and resolute. He looked toward where Mo Xiansheng was, saying softly: 'Old sir, I know you mean well for me. But some roads, are destined to only go forward.'"

"The contract materialized once more; this time, those terms seemed to come alive, stroke by stroke carving into Chen Ji's soul. Agony袭来—not physical pain, but the agony of a soul being torn apart and reorganized. He gritted his teeth, enduring it all without a sound."

choices.description: "Mo Xiansheng's words made him realize the contract must have ulterior motives. Better to maintain the status quo than sign a potentially catastrophic contract."
choices.visible_cost: "彻底得罪天机录意识，可能失去天机录残页的所有功能"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain independence; can seek other avenues later"
choices.risk_hint: "The Tianji Record consciousness won't let him go easily;后续必将面临更严酷的考验"

text.content: "'No signing.' Chen Ji's voice was resolute, 'I'd rather live fewer years than hand my life over to an unknown existence.' He looked into the depths of the void, 'Do as you wish, but Chen Ji's life, I decide myself.'"

"The void fell into deathly silence. That transcendent consciousness seemed to be重新审视他, and after a long while, let out a meaningful sigh: 'Spine. But do you think, after refusing, you can leave here safely?'"

"At this critical moment, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, this time clear and urgent: 'Chen Ji, the real contract isn't here! After the Tianji Record recognizes its master, it automatically generates a true contract—the one you're seeing now is just bait! Once the real contract is signed, your life, death, honor, and disgrace will all be bound to the Tianji Record, with no possibility of escape!'"

"Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He recalled the contract he saw earlier—clear terms, definite costs, seemingly fair. But precisely because of this, it seemed too easy. A contract that could change destiny, how could it be so easily laid before him, for him to pick and choose?"

"'You think I'm lying?' That voice from the eye of heaven suddenly turned icy, 'Mo Xiansheng is merely a wisp of residual soul; his memories are already incomplete. Everything he knows is old matters from three thousand years ago. I am the true will of the Tianji Record.' A terrifying pressure surged from the void, pressing directly toward Chen Ji."

"Two completely different voices intertwined and collided in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. On one side, Mo Xiansheng's urgent warning; on the other, the Tianji Record consciousness's pressure and temptation. Chen Ji felt his soul being torn between these two forces, almost splitting into pieces. He had to make a choice—and had to be quick."

choice.prompt: "Truth and lies intertwined; Chen Ji's soul wavered on the brink between two forces. He must give an answer before the Tianji Record consciousness's patience runs out—believe Mo Xiansheng's warning, or accept the Tianji Record's contract?"

choices.description: "Mo Xiansheng has guarded the Tianji Record Fragment for years; his warning is绝非空穴来风. The true contract must hide deadly traps; must not sign."
choices.visible_cost: "彻底激怒天机录意识，可能失去残页庇护"
choices.visible_reward: "Maintain freedom; can seek a true breakthrough method later"
choices.risk_hint: "The Tianji Record consciousness won't let this go;后续必有更凶险的考验"

text.content: "'Old sir, I believe you.' Chen Ji's voice was unusually clear amid the chaos. He turned to that consciousness in the void, saying coldly, 'Tianji Record consciousness, I don't care who you are or what you want. This contract, I will not sign.'"

"A violent tremor erupted in the void. That eye of heaven seemed enraged; terrifying pressure pressed toward Chen Ji like something substantial. However, at this moment, Mo Xiansheng's residual soul fiercely rushed out, standing before Chen Ji. 'I'll hold it off—run!'"

choices.description: "Mo Xiansheng's memories are indeed incomplete; old matters from three thousand years ago may not apply to today. Rather than overthink, might as well take the leap."
choices.visible_cost: "Lose free will; destiny thoroughly bound to the Tianji Record"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain complete Foresight Ability, and the Tianji Record consciousness's support"
choices.risk_hint: "Once signed, there is no turning back; if there is backlash, it will be catastrophic"

text.content: "'Mo Xiansheng, I'm sorry.' Chen Ji closed his eyes and made his decision, 'Old matters from three thousand years ago may not apply to today. Since the Tianji Record has already recognized its master, I choose to believe it.' He opened his eyes, looking into the void, 'I sign the contract.'"

"At that moment, the contract materialized once more. Golden light completely enveloped Chen Ji; his soul was pulled into a completely new realm. There, he saw his past, present, and countless possible futures. And among them, one future path shone with unprecedented brilliance."

"The moment the contract burned away completely, Chen Ji felt a tear open in his soul. Not pain, but a strange sense of fullness—as if something was forcibly stuffed into the depths of his consciousness. Those were a pair of eyes, capable of seeing everything that would happen within three shichen; that was a brand, thoroughly binding his fate with the Tianji Record."
"He猛地睁开眼睛，发现自己仍然跪在天机录残页之前。手心里，那页泛黄的纸张微微发热，上面的纹路比之前更加清晰了几分。而在陈机的眉心，一道淡金色的印记若隐若现，那是契约的标记。"

"'The contract is complete.' Mo Xiansheng's voice came from the fragment, carrying exhaustion, 'Chen Ji, from now on, you are the new inheritor of the Tianji Record. Your fate has been intertwined with this forbidden artifact.' The old man sighed, 'As for whether this is fortune or misfortune... only you can judge.'"

"Chen Ji slowly stood up, feeling that brand-new power within his body. It was a strange感知能力, as if whenever he wished, he could peek at anything that would happen within three shichen. But at the same time, he clearly sensed—his lifespan was indeed only twenty-three years remaining. This was the contract's cost, and also the path he chose."

"He lowered his head to look at his palm, a meaningful arc curving his lips. Twenty-three years was enough to do many things. Enough to find Chen Nian, enough to investigate the truth, enough to make those who despised him pay the price. The Tianji Record's contract was not a shackle, but a new piece on his board. And Chen Ji had always been that chess player."

"In the distance, the morning bells of Tianqing Sect rang悠悠响起. A new day began, and Chen Ji's fate changed completely at this moment. He tucked that page of paper close to his body and strode out of the underground secret chamber of the scripture library. Sunlight fell on him, yet could not illuminate the abyss in his eyes. From now on, he would walk through this underworld-surfaced cultivation world in the guise of waste, weaving his own chess game with the power of the Tianji Record."
